Hi, I don't think we have met. I'm Karen Mitchell, and I work for a grocery chain here in Chicago.
Nice to meet you, Karen. I'm Marcio Santos, and I'm from Sao Paulo, in Brazil.
Brazil, very nice. And what do you do there?
I work in pricing. My team decides the price of the products in a large wholesale company.
That is my world too. I look after the margin of the fresh categories. How often do you change your prices?
Almost every day. We follow the market, and we negotiate with every supplier before we decide.
Then you know the hard part. Most people think pricing is only a number on a shelf.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Global Retail Pricing Forum. My name is Rachel and I work with the conference team. The first session starts at nine thirty in the main hall, and the topic is price elasticity in food retail. Coffee is on the second floor, next to the registration desk. In the afternoon we have three parallel rooms, so please choose your session before lunch. If you need help, look for a person with a blue badge. We are here all day. Enjoy the forum.

Hello, this is David Cole from Kingsley Partners. I am calling about the Head of Pricing position we discussed by email. The client is a food retail group with stores in four countries, and they want to talk to you next week. The first interview is thirty minutes, by video, in English. They usually ask three things: what you do today, one result you are proud of, and why you want the role. Please send me two good times on Tuesday or Wednesday. Thank you, and have a good day.
